title: Special Edition: The Shield Hero’s Valentine’s Day Part 6
text: There’s a Filolial race tournament in Zeltoble. Since only the Queen and King are entering, I came over to the Filolial House to look for Motoyasu, but…
“Kue-kue-kue.”

The scent of chocolate wafts near the village’s Filolial House. It seems chocolate-making has started to catch on among the Filolials. Even though they only speak to me as “Kue,” the Filolials are melting and setting chocolate. Apparently, they’re helping out in preparation for the event… or so it seems.

By the way, is it really okay for Filolials to eat chocolate? Chocolate is supposed to be basically poisonous to animals, after all… If I say that, then Keel—the dog-like Demi-Human—would be the first one in trouble. He seemed fine, though.
“Ah, Master.”
Midori greets me, a stack of papers in one hand.
“Where’s Motoyasu?”
“Mr. Motoyasu went out to get a ticket for that female’s event.”

…By “that female,” she means Filo. So, does “ticket” refer to the exchange ticket for handmade chocolate? There are also handshake tickets, priority tickets for the next event, and all sorts of other things. Motoyasu usually stocks up on most of those kinds of tickets. You know the type—the one who buys a hundred or a thousand copies of an idol’s CD. That’s why the three Filolials are going to crash the event as rivals to compete with him.
“Kuu and Marin are tagging along with him.”
“And you?”
“I’m in the middle of selecting candidates for the next race in Motoyasu’s place.”

Hmm… Midori definitely seems like the most level-headed one in Motoyasu’s group. I get the feeling she’s getting the short end of the stick a bit, but I guess that’s what happens when you’re the only male among three females. To be honest, I’d love to lecture Motoyasu for about an hour for ditching work to go out and play, but since I don’t want to get close to him, I’ll just pretend I didn’t hear that. Maybe I’ll just brush it off with some casual small talk.
“Come to think of it, there was a marriage proposal for my Filolial and that famous Filolial from Zeltoble. How’s that going?”
If I get too caught up in stuff like this, there’s no end in sight, but it does spark a bit of curiosity from a game I used to play.

“Mr. Motoyasu doesn’t think he can hand over his precious children to some unknown scoundrels, so he doesn’t have the best opinion of those with pedigree certificates. That said, there are some kids who seem to have a good vibe about them, you know?”
“Hmm…”
I thought she’d be in absolute obedience to Motoyasu’s orders, but Midori seems to be analyzing the situation objectively.
“Actually, since it means fewer rivals, it’s a positive trend.”
Midori’s eyes lit up. Correction: This guy is pretty dangerous.
“Is that female going to compete? The other side seems to be wondering about that, too.”
“Filo? I don’t know. She’s probably too busy with her idol activities.”
“Hmph…”
“Stop smiling like you’ve already won. Motoyasu’ll get mad at you.”
Motoyasu doesn’t seem to care, but deep down, the whole Bitch incident is still a trauma for him. That’s why he has an extreme aversion to the negative aspects of women. Midori’s a male, though.

That said, I don’t recall seeing Motoyasu get angry recently, but he gets really loud if you make fun of Filo. Since he thinks of Midori as a kid, there’s a good chance he’d lecture him if Midori made fun of Filo.
“…Yeah. It seems the other side is also wondering if that female will participate.”
Ah, the organizers of the Filolial Race in Zeltoble. After all, Filo is in a league of her own when it comes to speed. She can fly, too… In that sense, it’s something to keep an eye on.
“So? Are Filolials with Vassal Weapons in a separate category?”
“That’s exactly the point. Because of the ability bonuses from our Vassal Weapons, it’s hard for me, Ku, and Marin to compete like that female does.”

In gambling, nothing is less exciting or rewarding than a sure win. Everyone plays it safe when betting. Even I would bet on Filo if there were a Filolial Queen & King Cup and Filo were participating. Though if Fitoria were to join, the outcome would be anyone’s guess. …She’d probably come if we invited her. She seems to think pretty much the same way as Filo. But still… if a legendary Filolial were to participate in something this trivial, it would be a blow to her prestige, wouldn’t it?
“So? Are you guys using your subordinate Filolials to make chocolate?”
“Half of them, anyway… Chick is leading the way and helping out.”

Ah, that’s Subordinate No. 1—the one who’s been pulling the carriage for Filo lately. I ignore her because she’s such a good actor, but she’s actually pretty smart. Come to think of it, Filo can’t make chocolate—can the other Filolials even do it? I’m really worried. Right now, the Filolials are playing around making chocolate near me, but it really is just like a game. It doesn’t look like something meant for sale—more like rough-and-ready gifts they’re making for each other.
“We just want to join in; we’re helping out in the back of the shed.”
“Can I take a quick look?”
“Yes. But Master, please peek in secretly through the shed window.”
“Is there something going on?”
“Yes.”

Upon hearing that, I sneak a peek inside the hut. Then, in the back of the hut… a curvaceous, sexy Arab-looking beauty—who looks great in glasses—is standing there with a document in hand, giving orders to the human-form Filolials who are tending to the pots set up inside.
“Please be careful with the temperature. Once this is done, move on to the next step.”

She’s got that “beautiful secretary” vibe. If you look closely, she’s got wings growing out of her back. Is that a Filolial too? She’s probably worried about loose feathers getting into the chocolate. But… who is that guy?
“I’m heading out now to help His Lordship with his shopping, everyone. Make sure you all do your jobs properly.”
“Okay!”
The other Filolials all look like little girls… but for some reason, he’s the only one who stands out. She adjusts the bow tie tied snugly around her neck and gives instructions, notebook in hand.
“After all, we Filolials are here to support His Lordship and the future Queen Filo.”
“‘Yeah!’”

They’re working the chocolate production line with a sense of mission burning inside them. I don’t really expect that much from you lot, though. To be honest, I didn’t even count on you from the start…
“Even if His Lordship never finds out, we’ll still be of help!”
That’s a noble aspiration. I feel like it resonates with me just a little.
“Chick, you’re really motivated, aren’t you?”
“Yes, indeed. That grumbling Rafraf creature stole the spot where His Lordship would pet me—I can’t let that grudge go unavenged!”
With a snap, she… Chick!?… snaps the pen she was holding in half. And in the back, a few Filolials are getting glared at by Chick.
“To be on friendly terms with that ‘Rafu-Rafu’ creature… it’s unforgivable!”
Ah, right—there were some folks in the village who turned into Raph-species creatures. Is it because she’s on good terms with them? I just witnessed something rather unpleasant.

You know, like the dark side of women? I almost got fooled by her selfless, unselfish attitude. I’ve thought this before, but that Chick really has a knack for doing things that get on my nerves without batting an eye. Just as I was thinking that…
“Raph-species?”

A Raph-species appeared right then from the ceiling. Where on earth did it come from? It’s almost like a horror movie. Well, I guess Raph-species do have a habit of popping up out of nowhere around here. It’s heading toward Chick.
“Ugh…”
“Raph-species?”
The Raph-species rubbed up against Chick’s feet, meowing as if begging to be petted. What on earth is it doing?
“Kuaaaa…”

As if she couldn’t stand it any longer, Chick scooped up the Raph-species, stroked it all over, and let out a sigh of relief. Then the Raph-species shifted into a different mode, grew larger, and started stroking Chick’s throat in return.
“Aaaah…”

…There’s kind of a lewd vibe in the air… Just as I thought that, Chick suddenly transformed into her Filolial form with a “puff,” and the Raph-species started petting her nonstop. After that, the two of them started petting each other happily. She’s getting petted right here, in the very spot where she just said it was unforgivable. And on top of that, she’s falling for it! Instant fall… Is this an eroge or something?
“Well, this is pretty much how we’re working.”
“I want to ask what exactly ‘this is pretty much how’ means… Are you guys on bad terms with the Raph-species?”
“No? Chick gets along with them pretty well, actually. She just says she’s jealous that Master gets to pet them.”
What kind of relationship is that? It’s gross. The Raph-species is one step ahead.
“Wait, so that guy can take human form?”
“Everyone can, actually.”
“Well, I figured that was probably the case…”
“It’s rare to see Chick transform, though.”
Is that so? I thought everyone looked like a little girl on the outside, like Filo. Oh well, if I worry about it, I’ll lose.
“I get it about Motoyasu. I’ll leave the selection of who to send to Midori… Frankly, how’s the management here handled?”
“I handle half of it, and Chick takes care of the rest.”

So the two of them are managing it? It must be tough with the higher-ups being like that. And Chick, for all her carefree Filolial demeanor, seems to have a pretty twisted mind, too. First she’s putting on a show, then she’s jealous—and she’s actually on good terms with the person she’s jealous of. That’s pretty complicated.
“Come to think of it, Chick… isn’t she about to head out on a buying trip with Goshu-jin-sama?　Should I go get Chick?”
“I’d rather have a different Filolial…”
“But then Chick will sulk, you know?”
So she doesn’t fight, but she sulks? What a pain…
“If you feel like it, please give Chick a pat.”
I’d rather pet Raph-chan, but I guess I have no choice. I can’t stand it if she causes another weird commotion.
“Well, we’ll be leaving in a little while, so please go ahead and call her.”
I wonder where Chick is headed—the one who’s supposedly being charmed by a Raph-species while feeling jealous of it. With that, I left the Filolial House and headed back home.
“What’s wrong, Naofumi-sama?”
“No… just a little something.”

Watching the Raph-species and the Filolial playfully roughhouse together left me with a complicated feeling. Is this what it feels like to give Motoyasu’s daughter away in marriage? I found myself empathizing with the Raph-species and wanting to tell her to stop playing around with that two-faced cat pulling a carriage. Thinking that made me feel empty inside.
Is this what they call “NTR”? No, no… Well, at least the one playing with him wasn’t Raph-chan, but the Raph-species.
“Raphtalia, you’re okay, right?”
“Um… what are you talking about?”

For now, I’ll just soothe my heart by watching Raphtalia’s tail until we set off. I don’t know if it’s because she’s been eating a lot of chocolate lately, but Raphtalia’s fur seems to be looking really nice.
“L-Lord Naofumi is actually making a move on me for once! But… it doesn’t seem much different from the look in his eyes when he’s looking at Raph-chan…”
That’s how I killed some time.
